detail.title: Experimental Distinctions Between Autocatalytic Memory and Template-Directed Heredity
detail.summary: This revised notebook distinguishes between persistent autocatalytic networks, defined by stoichiometric submatrix algebraic conditions, and template-directed heredity. While the former provides essential non-equilibrium persistence, it remains an insufficient condition for Darwinian heredity. Additional metadata regarding document structure memory was integrated, though it provides no substantive chemical evidence.
